para.text: Version 5.5
Added support for PRT models in MODFLOW 6.
The Grid and Mesh Values dialog box now can display the face numbering used in IFLOWFACE.
Added support for generating VOROGRIDGEN input files to generate DISV files for import into ModelMuse.
Added the ability to import DISV files without importing an entire model.
ModelMuse can now plot the 'STREAM FLOW OUT' data written by the STR package.
Added a warning if the NOGRB option is used when PEST is being used.
If the user attempts to specify pilot points with identical locations, the duplicate points will be ignored.
Added the ability to export objects to shapefiles when they define MODFLOW 6 observation locations.
Added support for UTVD in ADV packages for GWT and GWE.
Added Support for CRS option in the DIS and DISV packages.
Added Support for HIGHEST_CELL_SATURATION option in the NPF package.
Added Support for IMPLICIT option in the MODFLOW 6 LAK package.
Added Support for ATS_COURANT option in the MODFLOW 6 SFR package.
Added Support for ELASTIC_INELASTIC_SMOOTHING option in the CSUB package.
ModelMonitor now plots a separate budget for each SWI zone.
ModelMuse can now draw a point at the nodal point of each cell in a DISV grid.
ModelMuse can now draw lines connecting the nodal points of neighboring cells in a DISV grid.
When importing multiple gridded data files, the data sets will now have values set by interpolation as well as setting the values of intersected cells.

Specifying a log transformed parameter with an initial value less than or equal to zero now results in the generation of an error message in the Errors and Warnings dialog box instead of causing a divide by zero error.
Fixed bug that prevented CSUB Z-Displacement values from being imported.
Fixed access violation caused by attempting to sort the entries in the MT3D observations in the Data Visualization dialog box.
In the MODFLOW Program Locations dialog box, the edit control for MT3D-USGS now will display with a red background if MT3D-USGS is not installed at the specified location.
Fixed bug that could cause an access violation when exporting contours to Shapefiles.
Fixed export of duplicate time steps in SUTRA.
Changing a parameter for the LPF package to a PEST parameter now makes any associated multiplier or zone data sets optional instead of required That will cause the data sets to no longer be used.
Fixed pasting text for multiple cells into the GWT tabs for the MODFLOW 6 Lake, MAW, and UZF packages.
Fixed potential problem deleting temporary files.
Handled some errors reading and writing files.
Fixed bug that caused access violations when importing MODFLOW 6 GWT models that lacked the SSM package.
Fixed a bug in exporting contours to a Shapefile.
Fixed display of warning about unconnected grids in MODFLOW 6 models.
Fixed display of Data visualization dialog box in some models.
Fixed getting some FMP4 data in the MODFLOW Packages and Programs dialog box.
Fixed display of WBS (Farms) dialog box for MODFLOW OWHM version 1 models.
Fixed a bug in the export of objects to Shapefile that could cause assert violations, access violations, or the failure to export some fields.
Fixed import of CND package in GWE.
Fixed export of UZT and UWE concentrations.
Fixed import of MODFLOW 6 models containing more than one solute transport or energy transport models. Previously multiple data sets with identical names could be created.
Fixed bug in reading Auxiliary variables in the MAW package when importing MODFLOW 6 models.
Fixed bug in importing the CND package for GWE models.
Fixed bugs importing CSUB, LAK, MVR, and UZE packages.
